name: crm-sync
title: CRM sync for HubSpot, Pipedrive and Salesforce
description: Sends people who submit your forms to HubSpot, Pipedrive or Salesforce as contacts or leads, with field mapping, consent and retries.

forms.title: Forms to sync
forms.description: Form slugs, one per line. Empty means nothing is sent.

consent_field.title: Consent field
consent_field.description: Optional. When set, only submissions where this field is ticked or yes are sent.

add_note.title: Add a note with the message

lead_source.title: Lead source
lead_source.description: Salesforce: Lead Source on new records. HubSpot and Pipedrive: written in the note header.

owner_id.title: Owner id
owner_id.description: Optional CRM user id that owns NEW records. Digits for HubSpot and Pipedrive, a 15 or 18 character id for Salesforce.

access_token.title: HubSpot access token
access_token.description: HubSpot: private app access token. Stored here and never shown again.

lifecycle_stage.title: HubSpot lifecycle stage
lifecycle_stage.description: HubSpot: lifecycle stage sent with every contact.

api_token.title: Pipedrive API token
api_token.description: Pipedrive: personal API token. Stored here and never shown again.

create_lead.title: Pipedrive: create a lead
create_lead.description: Pipedrive: also create a lead for the person unless one exists.

client_id.title: Salesforce client id
client_id.description: Salesforce: consumer key of the app.

client_secret.title: Salesforce client secret
client_secret.description: Salesforce: consumer secret of the app. Stored here and never shown again.

default_company.title: Salesforce default company
default_company.description: Salesforce: Company used when none is mapped (required on Leads).
